title: Preserve selected-root ownership and reuse the owned identity kernel
status: both exactness fixes committed and locally qualified; matched controls complete; broader release readiness remains unproven

change.stage: first refinement fix; final combined changes and qualification are recorded under owned_singleton
change.summary: Only the included upper endpoint may supply a new point witness. Excluded lower-endpoint roots use the existing square-free/Sturm refiner; known exact points retain authority. Fast and fallback refinements share one metadata/validation update. Rational kind requires an exact rational payload. Midpoints use Real::average_pair.

cases.ownership: x(x-alpha) on (0,1], alpha=1 or 1/2; both policies; independent shared-refiner oracle and exact sign query
cases.public_count_scope: Both parameter orientations and policies; count the selected diagonal root and exclude the foreign zero root.
cases.metadata_scope: Rational 1/2, sqrt(2) and pi; upper endpoint, midpoint, repeated-root fallback and already-known exact point; both policies.

exactness.admission_scope: Structural/witness replay continues to trust the producer's unit-root certificate; this change does not add independent full root isolation to admission.

native_validation.concurrent_dependency_scope: Current-workspace gates include ongoing Hyperreal queries_conversion.rs edits after d219a35. Paired timing artifacts instead freeze d219a35 production dependencies on both sides.

profile.source: current pre-fix Hypercurve with Hypersolve 1841884 and Hyperreal d219a35
profile.caveat: Optimized Rust call-chain unwinding is incomplete. Self samples identify arithmetic/allocation cost, but do not establish which caller should be changed.

frozen_comparison.status: intermediate first-stage artifacts retained; final comparisons use the original frozen baseline and owned_singleton candidate artifacts
frozen_comparison.size_interpretation: Region executable grows 7176 file bytes while text/data/BSS total is unchanged. Retained for the proven exactness fixes; no size or speed gain is claimed.

downstream_validation.scope: Core matrices and opt-in fixtures preceded the second production change; ancillary builds spanned it. The completed final second-stage matrix is recorded under owned_singleton.downstream_validation.

remaining: ExactCorelib mining/uplift remains closed from previous work.
Full Hypercurve release readiness and uniformly competitive operation performance remain unproven.
Audit and remove the redundant root-kind tag if full consumer review confirms the current findings; no compatibility API should replace it.
Evaluate native Real::eval_poly reuse and identical private sign helpers with controlled benchmarks.
Full slow-fixture paired allocation accounting from the previous pass remains incomplete; only scoped RSS and small-fixture allocation evidence is claimed.
No push, registry publication or hosted deployment was performed by this pass.

owned_singleton.change: All three local-field identity sites use polynomial_vanishes_at_owned_root, the existing selected-root identity kernel. A zero-width singleton without an optional point witness is no longer misread as an empty half-open interval.

downstream_validation.scope: Final full native, Hypercurve and UI/WASM gates on the committed combined changes. Concurrent Hyperreal conversion edits remain separate from the frozen timing artifacts.

allocation_control.scope: Small unchanged fixture including process startup. This tiny difference is not allocation accounting for the full Boolean fixture or a scoped leak-freedom claim.

matched_comparison.interruption: Independent Cargo/test/compiler jobs appeared around 19:45:42 UTC during baseline-2. The owned comparison script was stopped with exit 130 at 19:48:07 UTC. No competing workers were stopped. Original group order is preserved across the pause.
matched_comparison.interpretation: Three samples per artifact and fixture, with contended/interrupted samples excluded and preserved. Selected-fiber median changes 52.39 to 52.27 seconds, chord 17.19 to 16.93, radial 29.39 to 30.10, and region 6.51 to 6.42. The radial control is 2.42% slower; individual region lanes are mixed. These are not a statistical or uniformly faster-operation claim. The fixes are retained for their demonstrated exactness value.
matched_comparison.output_checks: Every test invocation passed exactly one test; all 19 region rows preserved iteration counts and every emitted checksum.

local_pages.visual_inspection: Default polyline/curved-region scene, controls and grid render correctly. Screenshot matches the previously inspected startup image byte-for-byte.
local_pages.scope: Local startup only, not interactive all-tab or hosted-deployment qualification.
